# glm5-gb300-dyn13-1k1k-ll-c256-1p17d-bs32

Kubernetes port of `glm5-gb300-fp8-stp-lowlatency-1p17d-bs32-conc512x256x128x64.yaml` for GLM-5 FP8 on GB300.

- Workload: 1k_1k, bounded AIPerf synthetic input with seed 0 over completions
- Concurrency: 256
- Measured requests: 10 × concurrency
- Warmup requests: 2 × concurrency
- Topology: 1 prefill nodes / 17 decode nodes, 72 GB300 GPUs
- Runtime: Dynamo 1.3.0 + SGLang 0.5.14, pinned linux/arm64 image digest
- Source context length: 9600

## How to reproduce

Run these steps from `inference/k8s_recipes/`. This cell uses a versioned node-local model cache, so prepare that cache once before the first run.

```bash
# 1 · pick your cluster → writes cluster-profiles/<profile>.env  (one-time, per cluster)
scripts/llmb-k8s init

# 2 · install THIS recipe: namespace + secrets + model-cache PVC + weights  (safe to re-run)
scripts/llmb-k8s install <profile> --recipes glm5-gb300-dyn13-1k1k-ll-c256-1p17d-bs32

# 3 · prepare the versioned node-local cache once, then wait for its DaemonSet rollout
#     follow serving/sglang-disagg-gb300/node-cache/README.md

# 4 · run it: preflight → serve → sweep → results (GPUs freed on the way out)
scripts/llmb-k8s run recipes/llm-perf/Glm5/Gb300_k8s/Disagg/sglang_dynamo/1k_1k/lowlatency/glm5-gb300-dyn13-1k1k-ll-c256-1p17d-bs32 <profile> --teardown --fetch
```
